## Rule

Object = the single connected shape. Complete it into a **4-fold rotationally-symmetric** pattern:
overlay the object with its 90°/180°/270° rotations about the object's center (integer center for
odd-sized objects, half-integer center for even-sized). Team-best (Vamshi, **4839**) implements this as
TopK-find-cells → GridSample-read-colors → detect-center → scatter object + 3 rotations → pad → one-hot.
Full decode in `task361/hard_records/gridsample_padassembly_levers.md`.

## Cost analysis

Scoring: memory = Σ intermediate bytes (max static/runtime), `input`/`output` tensors excluded by name;
params = Σ initializer **element counts** (not bytes). Dominant charged items: `completed_scalar30`(900),
`sampled_colors`(600 GridSample out), `bg_flat_f`+`bg10_f`(800 F32, feed TopK — U8 TopK unsupported here),
`sample_grid_table`(200 params), `scatter_idx_i32`(240). All are structurally forced; see hard_records.

## Don't-do log

- **Coord table [100,2]→per-axis LUT**: LOSES (measured 4891). `Gather` rejects int16 indices (ORT
  INVALID_GRAPH) so col/row must be cast to I32 (+120 B) and re-interleaved (+120 B), exceeding the 188-param
  saving. The pre-interleaved `[100,2]` one-Gather layout is optimal.
- **Static color read (no GridSample)**: any channel-collapse materializes ≥3600 B (`Conv`/`MatMul` →
  `[1,1,30,30]` F32) or ≥4000 B (sliced `[1,10,10,10]`); GridSample's 15-point sample (~800 B) can't be beaten.
- **Scalar-pad 30×30 (900 B)**: forced by `[1,10,30,30]` output; one-hot-pad alt is 1000 B (worse).
- Stale note (2026-05-20 PR_BIG): F16 strategies NO_WIN — still holds against the current graph (already F16/U8 internally).
